caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile with a woven design in shades of pink and beige. The textile has a prominent border on the left side consisting of a pink diagonal stripe pattern, and the bottom edge is finished with a beige fringe. The main body of the textile is divided into several decorative sections, including geometric and floral motifs in pink set against a beige background. The upper right portion displays a repeating pattern of large stylized flowers and smaller dot accents. The lower left section includes pictorial elements such as a house or building, trees, and human figures. There is also a section with text arranged in several lines, featuring the name "ROBERT ALEXANDER DEFI ANCE FIELD OHIO." Below the text, there is a scene with two horses with riders facing each other, a central animal figure, and additional smaller animals, as well as other geometric patterns and a row of small animals on the bottom border. The composition is symmetric and organized, with clear color contrast between the pink design elements and the beige background.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
